# Third-party models (CC BY 4.0)

These models were supplied by the user (Sketchfab downloads, `temp-asset/`, not in git) and converted with
`Game/Tools/glb/convert_glb.py` (merged, decimated, per-face colour sampled into a flat palette, which removes any printed
text, hull numbers or insignia; renamed to fictional ids). The in-game credit line is `SettingsPanel.Credits`
(Settings screen). Store-listing notes: `Game/Docs/STORE-CREDITS.md`.

| In-game id | Folder | Source title | Author | Source | Licence | Modified |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `shared_scout_drone` | `SharedScoutDrone/` | Zala_421_16E2 | Viktor_ (https://sketchfab.com/Viktor.Zhuravlev) | https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/zala-421-16e2-25c8c177042340238af814ded16ca24b | CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | decimated 9,950 → 2,800 tris, textures replaced by flat palette, renamed |
| `cf_ironwall_battleship` | `CfIronwallBattleship/` | Lowpoly Hms hood | SIpriv (https://sketchfab.com/S1Priv) | https://sketchfab.com/3d-models/lowpoly-hms-hood-e08f6df07350462aaa4a2d91c3180e14 | CC BY 4.0 (http://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/) | cut at the waterline, decimated 83,102 → 16,778 tris, 23 textures replaced by one flat palette (markings removed), renamed |

The source titles are kept only here as attribution records; they are not used in code, data, UI or file names.
